CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenh_subscription_snapshot(p_business businesses)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('plan',p_business.subscription_plan_key,'users',p_business.subscription_user_limit,
 'branches',p_business.subscription_branch_limit,'basePlan',p_business.subscription_base_plan_key,
 'start',extract(epoch FROM p_business.subscription_started_at),'end',extract(epoch FROM p_business.subscription_expires_at),
 'cycle',p_business.subscription_cycle_value,'monthly',p_business.subscription_monthly_price,'months',p_business.subscription_months);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenh_custom_plan_monthly_price(p_users integer, p_branches integer)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_user_base numeric;
begin
  if p_users not between 1 and 500 or p_branches not between 1 and 100 then
    raise exception 'Choose valid Custom Plan user and branch counts.';
  end if;
  v_user_base:=case
    when p_users<=5 then 10+(p_users-1)*2
    when p_users<=10 then 18+(p_users-5)*4
    else 38+(p_users-10)*5
  end;
  return v_user_base+greatest(0,p_branches-1)*20;
end; $function$
